dogecoin.text:
#Dogecoin has been used as a tipping system on Reddit and X to reward content creators.

Tip a content creator with #DOGE today 🙂‍↔️

DOGE-- Do Only Good Everyday🫵 https://t.co/WRBpup0nch

This has raised questions within the crypto space, especially from those who believe scarcity drives value. 

Supporters argue that this steady supply encourages spending and circulation rather than hoarding, making #Dogecoin more suitable for everyday transactions.

Though it started as a joke, @dogecoin became valuable and was traded on major exchanges.

One of the most significant times in dogecoin history was when @elonmusk made a tweet about @dogecoin 

That tweet alone surged popularity and increased the price of dogecoin. https://t.co/xyzGkRMVVS

The @dogecoin community grew quickly and became known for generosity and humor, they tipped content creators, funded charities, and even funded some major stuffs like

Sponsored the Jamaican bobsled team to the Winter Olympics

Sponsored a NASCAR driver with a Dogecoin-themed car

Although they’re risky, but with the right timing, trading them can be profitable.

@dogecoin itself is becoming more stable and is one of the few showing signs of real utility, like being accepted for payments.

Despite starting as an accidental crypto movement, @dogecoin was the start of something different, proving that community and vibes could drive value

Since then, other coins like Shiba Inu, Pepe, have followed, showing that even coins with no deep utility can still move markets.

Then in 2013 the @dogecoin was created by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer as a joke currency.

It was originally created as a fork on @litecoin and it later developed it's own blockchain using a proof of work(PoW) consensus mechanism and a scrypt hashing algorithm.

The @dogecoin was simply created out of a meme.

A Japanese lady had posted photos of her dog: Kabosu on social media which is a shiba inu (dog breed). 

A lot of people found one particular picture really cute, it went viral and became the face of the doge meme. https://t.co/zuPzlTUaPd

I had heard of fundamental analysis and technical analysis and a little here and there but I didn't understand jack so I was moving like a robot.

Soo.... how did @dogecoin come about 

Here's how🔻

Someone had asked me why I bought #Dogecoin and honestly I bought it because that was the only coin I had heard of at the time that had a good reputation, at least to me🤷

Then, I had a very shallow knowledge of the whole cryptocurrency thing.

#Dogecoin was the first coin I ever bought, which was in 2023, although I had plans to HODL but I sold because I needed the money, this was when doge was around $0.06-$0.08.
